title: Emitted size selection
responsibility: Names per-target artifact limits and selects build measurements that qualify for those frozen limits.

inputs.name: emittedKey.target
inputs.description: The execution target name appended after the colon of the artifact-bytes ledger key, so each target's frozen emitted size has its own key. The function accepts any string and does not validate or trim it, so the key uses the value exactly as given.

inputs.name: emittedSizes.measurements
inputs.description: The measurements to filter, each with a required metric and optional target, profile and workload fields. The helper reads those fields without validating the list or changing any entry, and keeps only artifact-bytes entries that have a target and no profile or workload.

outputs.name: emittedMetric
outputs.description: The constant 'artifact-bytes', the metric name that every emitted size is measured under. emittedSizes keeps only entries whose metric equals this constant, so entries with any other metric are never selected.

outputs.name: emittedKey
outputs.description: The ledger key an emitted size is frozen under, made of the metric name artifact-bytes, a colon, and the supplied target. The target is appended exactly as given, with no validation in this function.

outputs.name: emittedSizes
outputs.description: The measurements that qualify as frozen per-target emitted sizes: metric is artifact-bytes, target is defined, and profile and workload are each absent or empty. Benchmark sizes that carry a profile or workload are excluded, and the returned entries are the same objects as the input, in their original order.
